name: Simulador StreamHub
storyline:
You begin with only a handful of viewers, a regular job and the dream of one day becoming a full-time streamer. What starts as a small channel gradually becomes a fifteen-year journey through growth, friendships, opportunities, setbacks, changing communities and the unpredictable realities of building a life around streaming.

Every stage of your career can take you somewhere different. Success is never guaranteed, and reaching the top is only one possible ending. Whether your channel becomes something worth remembering—or disappears along the way—depends on the path your career ultimately takes.
summary: Simulador StreamHUB is a browser-based career simulation game about building and managing a streaming career. Players make quarterly decisions while managing audience growth, money, energy, community, equipment, staff, employment and streaming platforms. Random events, quick-time events, crises and different career outcomes make each playthrough unfold differently.
